The climate in Montana

Montana is about 150 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 30°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −3°C. Around 710 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in May (about 86 mm).

Montana lies in north-western Bulgaria on the Ogosta river, between the Danubian Plain and the western Balkan Mountains. The climate is moderate continental, with cold winters and hot summers. The Ogosta reservoir next to the town and the nearby mountain slopes bring a little more precipitation than on the plain further north.
